name: Veltrixo Device Repair Quote Form
author: Ali Hossain

sections.description:
A fully featured repair shop booking form with 5 guided steps:

  1. Device — Phone, Tablet, Computer, Gaming Console, Smartwatch, and more
  2. Brand/Model — Dynamic brand list based on selected device, with an optional model name field
  3. Issue — Multi-select repair issues (Broken Screen, Battery, Camera, etc.)
  4. Details — Customer info form with contact details
  5. Appointment — Interactive calendar and time slot picker

Features:

  • Live summary sidebar showing selected device, issues, and warranty info
  • Thank-you screen with full booking summary after submission
  • Admin bookings table with pagination
  • Email notification to the shop on each booking
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • Manage devices, brands/models, sub-models, and issues from the admin Settings page
  • Color customization via Admin > Settings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/veltrixo-device-repair-quote-form directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Veltrixo Device Repair Quote Form > Settings to configure your shop info, devices, models, and issues.
  4. Add the [veltrixo_device_repair_quote] shortcode to any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add the form to a page?

Add the shortcode [veltrixo_device_repair_quote] to any page or post.

Where do I see submitted bookings?

Go to Veltrixo Device Repair Quote Form > Bookings in your WordPress admin menu.

Can I customize the devices, brands, and issues shown in the form?

Yes. Go to Veltrixo Device Repair Quote Form > Settings and use the Devices, Models/Brands, Sub-Models, and Issues tabs.
